label: WixQA SYNTHETIC SECONDARY GENERALIZATION LOCK (new questions, familiar corpus) — FINAL; prepared from development questions only; Synthetic outcomes read: 0; test NOT run
question: Does the already-developed WixQA FusionContextPlan generalize to a large unseen question population on the same WixQA corpus?
role: SECONDARY evidence. Never used to change the FusionContextPlan. If it fails, report the disagreement and investigate only after the result is frozen.

systems.tokenBudget: per query = Global Fixed context tokens

derivation.data: WixQA ExpertWritten+Simulated DEVELOPMENT (optimization) questions only, n=280, full KB

rules: R1 exact duplicate of any primary question (400)
R2 near-duplicate of any primary question (content-word Jaccard >= 0.6)

testSubsample.decision: Option A approved by the user (2026-10-06): seeded random 4,000 of the 6,192 eligible questions, within the preregistered 2 h evaluation budget.

primary.metric: Recall@5 (1 gold per question: equals Success@5 per question)
primary.productDecisionRule: delta >= +5.0 AND CI excludes 0 (a decision rule; does not by itself establish a true effect >= 5)

externalWording: Report point estimate + paired 95% CI; describe threshold outcomes as decision-rule outcomes.

resourceProjection.representations: existing WixQA full-scale V1 caches (section, sentence-window with MiniLM)

recordedExpectation: Positive. WixQA actual-engine out-of-fold development CV: +4.7 [+1.3, +8.2]; final-fit training gain +5.6 [+2.4, +8.8] (in-sample). Synthetic questions are LLM-generated with 1 gold article, a different distribution from the development questions.
operational: Keep the machine awake for the run (an OS sleep pauses but does not invalidate quality; latency would be re-measured only if a sleep overlaps the latency pass).
frozen: eligible population (6,192 ids, sha256 ad389ccde9d5af6f79a57c5c328e4483fcecc42df1ee70d303da8595b9c51e13) and exclusion rules R1-R4
test subsample (n=4,000, seed 20261001) and latency subsample (n=300, seed 20261001)
Global plan and partner (WixQA-derived), RRF k=60, no shared rerank, rerank pool 20
token budget rule: fused context <= Global Fixed context tokens per query
metrics, paired bootstrap (10,000, seed 20261001), scientific rule, product decision rule
evaluator and analysis scripts at the lock commit

interpretation.significantPositive: Delta > 0 with CI excluding 0: FusionContextPlan generalizes to a large unseen question population on the same corpus.
interpretation.null: CI includes 0: the EnterpriseRAG result remains valid, but the benefit of fusion is workload-dependent.
interpretation.significantNegative: Delta < 0 with CI excluding 0: evidence that the current offline partner-selection/gating method is insufficiently robust.
interpretation.noRerun: No outcome triggers a rerun, an alternate configuration, or any change evaluated on Synthetic. Any investigation happens only after the result is committed.
